x: The second was won by Maurice Nye who we had not seen since the early winter, but who must have been doing plenty of secret training. We look forward to seeing him more with the lads in the future.
Maurice Nye took 3rd individual handicap and our "A" Team of Nye, Newson, True and Hall were 2nd handicap Team. Considering the state of the day, the lads walked very well, and what a day!
Could Eric and Syd continue their good form, and what of George Beecham, Maurice Nye, Bill True and Doub, who was going to make up the team.
On 3rd July Ted Smith won the Business Houses 2 miles Track Walking Championship. D, McMullen was 3rd and M.
